articles.author: GEN Restaurant Group, Inc.
articles.headline: GEN Restaurant Group Board Approves Binding LOI with Chubby Group for $100 Million Restaurant Transaction
articles.summary: GEN announces board approval of a binding LOI to sell operations at 47 restaurants for a stated $100 million while retaining its brand and packaged-food business. Closing, licenses, leases and definitive agreements remain conditions. The release describes a term note and potential equity conversion, not a completed $100 million cash receipt.
